candidate_invariant.name: explicit RLE boundary
candidate_invariant.claim_form: For each system s in the frozen cohort, the system exhibits an explicit Reasoning->Legitimacy->Execution boundary.

per_system_operational_definition.condition: documented, named reasoning artifact type whose role is to express or compute authorization-relevant reasoning and can be referenced independently of a particular execution
documented decision point that evaluates a request or proposed state change against reasoning artifacts and yields a legitimacy outcome
documented enforcement mechanism that uses the legitimacy outcome to permit, deny, or otherwise gate the real-world action
documented separable interface or equivalent contract between reasoning artifacts and legitimacy evaluation
documented separable interface or equivalent contract between legitimacy outcome and execution or enforcement

admitted_evidence_types_ordered: Normative specifications (RFCs, formal specs, language specifications)
Official product documentation (vendor/project docs) and reference architecture descriptions
Official API references / configuration schema references
Official upstream source code only to resolve ambiguities in admitted documentation/specifications and only when a stable tag or commit is recorded
admitted_evidence_rule.inclusion_rule: A system/feature claim is admissible only if supported by at least one admitted evidence item recorded in BORs with version and retrieval metadata.

cohort_rule.support_condition: The cohort supports the candidate invariant only if every system in the frozen cohort is classified as supports under I5.
exclusion_criteria: Duplicate implementations of already represented architectures

measurement_vector.unit_of_analysis: system s in the frozen cohort

components.name: m_RL
components.meaning: explicit documented interface/contract between reasoning artifacts and legitimacy evaluation

components.name: m_LE
components.meaning: explicit documented interface/contract between legitimacy outcome and execution/enforcement

measurement_vector.computation_constraint: Each measurement must be computed solely from DER entries whose trace resolves to admitted BOR evidence under I2; unavailable measurements are recorded as missing, not coerced.

per_system_classification.condition: any of m_R, m_L, m_E, m_RL, or m_LE is missing
otherwise; at least one required component is present and equals 0

cohort_outcome.condition: there exists a system with per-system classification indeterminate
there exists a system with per-system classification violates
all systems have per-system classification supports

unresolved_fields.reason: The inspected canonical registration text requires BOR version/retrieval metadata but does not itself provide specific source versions, retrieval dates, URLs, commits, or hashes.
The inspected canonical registration text states the general rule for constraining analyst discretion but does not enumerate cohort-specific discretionary choices.
